capabilities: Generate practice questions from notes and PDFs using a chosen AI provider
Schedule daily review sessions with spaced repetition and skill-aware queues
Track recall fluency from correctness, skips, and response time
Manage providers and API keys via settings and secret storage
Show a dashboard with streak, due notes, and scan status
extras: Per the manifest, this plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. On desktop it downloads and launches a checksum-verified native helper process, which triggers security scanner warnings; mobile avoids this entirely. PDF generation requires Anthropic or Gemini and is capped at 10 MB per file.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn notes into active practice material with AI-generated questions and adaptive review scheduling.

relations.evidence: Via the BRAT plugin (recommended for tracking this repo)
Runs against your local Ollama server. No API key, free, fully offline.
this plugin runs a native helper program (the open-source Whetstone engine) as a separate process

requires.name: AI provider API key (Gemini, Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, OpenRouter, or custom endpoint)
Claude Code or Codex CLI signed in, or a local Ollama server, for those providers; Whetstone engine binary on desktop

summary: AI-powered plugin that generates practice questions from notes and PDFs with spaced repetition scheduling and adaptive difficulty.
